summary: Tested the Nellai Karupatti Coffee manager app end-to-end. Backend: all 16 pytest cases PASS (auth, employees CRUD + status toggle, leaves upsert, advances incl. zero-deletes, salary arithmetic 18000-1200-500=16300 verified, dashboard stats). Frontend: landing, login, dashboard KPIs, sidebar, employees add/toggle/delete, leaves save, salary table & Export CSV all work. Found one CRITICAL UI bug: on /advances the 'Apply to all' button is visually overlapped by the 'Clear all' button and cannot be clicked (Playwright pointer-intercept confirms).

minor.issue: Deleting an employee leaves orphan rows in leave_entries and advance_entries; dashboard still shows total_leave_days/month_advance_total for non-existent employees.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Apply to all' button (x=834-939) is overlapped by 'Clear all' button (x=886-1018) on desktop; Playwright reports Clear-all intercepts pointer events on Apply-to-all. Root cause: the input group inside lg:col-span-4 uses `flex` without min-w-0/width cap, making the Apply button extend past its column into lg:col-span-2. Fix hints: wrap Apply button in a sibling column (e.g. col-span-3/3/2/..) OR set `min-w-0 overflow-hidden` on the flex row, or move the Apply button into its own col.

issues: When zero current employees exist, Quick figures card still shows 'Total leave days: 2' and 'Total advances given: ₹500' because orphan entries remain after employee deletion (see backend minor).

action_items: Fix Advance Entry layout so 'Apply to all' and 'Clear all' don't overlap (restructure the 12-col grid or put Apply in its own column; at viewport 1920x1080 the overlap is ~53px and Clear blocks Apply).
On DELETE /api/employees/{id}, also remove db.leave_entries and db.advance_entries for that employee_id (and/or filter dashboard stats to current employees only).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py save_leaves/save_advances run update_one sequentially in a loop — fine for tiny rows but consider bulk_write for scale.
salary_for_month regex `^{month}` works but an index on advance_entries.date would help at scale; current index is compound (employee_id, date).

AdvanceEntry layout uses grid lg:grid-cols-12 with col-spans 3+4+2+3 but the input+Apply group inside col-4 overflows its column on desktop, causing the Clear-all in col-2 to stack on top. Needs layout fix.
Dashboard /api/dashboard/stats sums advances/leaves for the current month irrespective of employee status; orphan records inflate the numbers after deletion.

seed_data_creation: Test created and then cleaned up TEST_/UI_/ZZ_ prefixed employees. Leave/advance entries for 2026-05/2026-07 that belonged to those employees are NOT cleaned up by the app on DELETE — they remain as orphans and inflate dashboard figures. After my manual cleanup only 0 employees remain (as user had).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is the regression. Main open item is the Advance Entry button-overlap. After fix, re-open /advances at 1920x1080, assert advance-apply-bulk and advance-clear bounding boxes do not intersect, and that clicking Apply to all fills all row inputs.
rca of the issue: AdvanceEntry top control panel uses `grid lg:grid-cols-12` with column spans 3/4/2/3. Inside the 4-col cell, a `flex` row contains currency span + number input (flex-1) + 'Apply to all' button (whitespace-nowrap, ~105px). At viewport 1920 with max-w-5xl (1280px) container minus sidebar/padding, the 4-col cell is ~320px but the flex row's minimum content width (including the 105px button) pushes past the cell boundary because flex items lack `min-w-0`. The adjacent 2-col cell hosting the full-width 'Clear all' button then gets rendered on top of the protruding Apply button, intercepting clicks. Reproduction: login as admin, go to /advances at 1920x1080, inspect data-testid=advance-apply-bulk (x+w=939) vs data-testid=advance-clear (x=886) — 53px overlap. Mitigation: either (a) restructure the grid (e.g. 3/3/3/3 with Apply in its own col), (b) add `min-w-0` to the input and/or the 4-col wrapper, or (c) reduce max-width of the bulk input group.
